messages:
alex: hey team — PR ready: https://git.redwood/infra/pull/61234. small change: adaptive eviction header + fallback-routing tweak. needs runtime + infra + security eyes before i can merge. planning to cut canary tomorrow morning (09:30 PT). anyone available to review or own canary?

maya: pinged. quick q — does this change the KV key format or only how we choose fallback pools?

alex: only routing selection; no KV format changes. we do set a new header `x-evict-policy: adaptive` on internal calls so runtime needs to ensure header is ignored by cache keying. tests added to cover that.

sam: tagging infra — does this require any LB config changes or new ports?

alex: no new ports. LB behavior unchanged. infra only needs to confirm we won't hit any new healthcheck assumptions — i added a fallback route that may increase 503s for ~30s during canary ramp.

rachel: security question: who can tell me if `x-evict-policy` can be set by user traffic or only internal services? if it's writable by clients we need authz checks.

alex: good call. header is internal-only, set by the orchestrator service. i added a quick middleware that rejects it from external requests; see snippet in PR: 

```
if (req.headers['x-evict-policy'] && !req.isInternal) {
  return res.status(400).send('forbidden header');
}
```

alex: also added unit tests and an integration canary plan in the PR description. CI passed on my branch (all unit + e2e).

dev-bot: CI: all checks passed — unit: 1223 tests, e2e: 214 tests. build: green.

maya: ok i'll skim for runtime hazards: need to ensure KV cache keying ignores that header at the fast-path. can you paste perf numbers from the micro-benchmark?

alex: micro-bench (local, p50/p95/p99 tokens/sec): 1200 / 980 / 710 before, 1188 / 970 / 700 after. overhead ~1.5% p50. added back-compat toggle `FEATURE_FLAG_EVICT_ADAPTIVE` for 2h rollback window.

sam: infra ack in principle, will run quick LB smoke tomorrow during canary ramp. no config changes from infra side.

rachel: thanks — that middleware looks fine but please add an explicit test that external requests with header fail (integration). also add a short note in the security runbook about allowed internal callers.

alex: will add both now. doing the integration test and runbook snippet in a follow-up commit.

ben: i can own rollback/monitoring for the canary window tomorrow. tag me when you cut it and i'll watch telemetry. :eyes:

alex: awesome, thanks @ben. plan is to cut canary 09:30 PT, 10% traffic for 30m, then 50% for 30m if stable. i'll update PR description with exact deploy commands.

maya: small nit in PR: you added a `TODO` in runtime path referring to `ignoreHeader` — can you either resolve or leave a clear follow-up ticket? otherwise lgtm from runtime side.

alex: resolved TODO, left ticket INFRA-2339 for follow-up. pushed fix.

rachel: marked security as ok to review after your integration test + runbook snippet.

alex: pushed integration test + runbook note. CI re-run in progress.

dev-bot: CI: re-run queued...

alex: tagging final owners: @maya (runtime), @sam (infra), @rachel (security), @ben (rollback/monitor). would appreciate quick eyes so i can merge before the canary window.

maya: giving runtime :thumbsup: — i'll add a short comment on the PR about the cache fast-path verification steps.

sam: infra :thumbsup:, will be on-call for the ramp.

rachel: security :thumbsup: pending the integration test green.

ben: i'll be around tomorrow morning. :ok_hand:

alex: thanks everyone — will merge after final CI green and a quick thumbs.

dev-bot: CI: all checks passed. build: green. mergeable: yes.
